scheme_name: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Widows
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep
Must have only nominal income, not exceeding ₹1,500 per month
Must not be a beneficiary of any other similar pension scheme provided by the government
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 (₹18,000 per annum) transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account.
